project.title: Bacterial community analysis of sewage sludge treated by Hermetia illucens and EM-bacterial agent
project.description: Amplicon sequencing (16S rRNA gene, 338F-806R) was performed to investigate bacterial community profiles of sewage sludge after treatment with Hermetia illucens combined with EM bacterial agent. Three biological replicates were included for each treatment.
